items.text: Limits reset every 12 hours. Your timer starts when you send your first message on an empty limit, and the usage pop-up shows exactly how long is left, down to the second.

Faster answers. Everyday messages are answered straight away again, and the web is only searched when your question needs fresh info. If a Gemini model stops responding, NEON AI now moves on to the next one after a few seconds instead of hanging.
Cleaner search answers. Fixed web-search answers sometimes starting with a box of raw code. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite now gets its web results in a more reliable way.
Chat list. Fixed the chat you hover over growing taller than the others. All rows are the same size now.
Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite can search the web now, and if a Gemini model fails or gives an empty answer, NEON AI automatically tries the next one (3.5 Flash-Lite, 2.5 Flash, then 3.6 Flash).
Web search for every model. Gemini and Claude can now search the web, so they know about recent news, releases and prices, and they list their sources under the answer.
See what it's doing. Instead of just loading dots, you now see each step live: thinking, searching, reading sources. Open the summary above an answer to see what it looked up.
Proper maths. Equations, fractions, roots and symbols now show as real maths instead of messy code, in inline text and in big centred equations.
Code blocks. Fixed an oversized Copy button that could appear on code blocks.
Default model. A fresh open of NEON AI now always starts on Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite. Refreshing the page keeps the model you were using.

/chess for playing chess against a bot you choose.
/larp for practising trading with fake money, with a beginner tutorial you can skip.
Daily usage ring. A ring beside your name shows how much of your limit you have used. Click it for the details, and find the same info in Settings.
Make real files. Ask for a PDF, Word, PowerPoint or Excel file and download the real thing, with a live preview first.
Code and web previews in a safe panel, with fullscreen.
Accounts. Sign in with Google or an email code, reset your password, and pick a plan. The Free plan now has 25,000 Gemini tokens a day.
Smoother everything. Nicer dropdowns, longer replies that continue on their own, and this update log.
